jobTitle: Senior Full-stack Engineer, Core AI Services
jobDescription:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title: Senior Full-stack Engineer, Core AI Services

Location: Cambridge, United Kingdom (Hybrid) 

Employment Type: full-time 


The job 

We are looking for passionate Senior Software/Full-stack Engineers to join our Core AI Services team at the forefront of industrial AI Innovation. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services, agentic workflows, and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across AVEVA’s product portfolio and partner ecosystem. 

Working at the forefront of agentic systems and harness engineering, you will join an agile Scrum team with a true builder mindset—delivering innovative, secure, and production-grade AI capabilities with the agility of a startup. This role is ideal for an engineer with a genuine passion for keeping up with the latest AI engineering patterns and practices, eager to translate emerging tech into reliable, enterprise-ready software. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure. 
  • Develop and maintain clean, responsive web user interfaces and developer tools using Angular to complement core AI platform services and public APIs.  
  • Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal engineering teams and external partners. 
  • Drive feature implementation from design to production, taking ownership of code quality, performance, and system reliability. 
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration layers, and service APIs. 
  • Embed robust security controls, identity management, and privacy-by-design practices across all AI services. 
  • Actively contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to champion engineering best practices. 
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. 

Core Skills and Qualifications:  

  • 5–8+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, with strong expertise in cloud-native backend development (.NET C# a plus) and modern web frameworks (Angular). 
  • Hands-on experience with containerised deployments in Kubernetes. 
  • Deep understanding of RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and full lifecycle management. 
  • Strong knowledge of securing APIs (OAuth2, OIDC, RBAC) and implementing data privacy best practices. 
  • Proficiency in using modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate daily engineering workflows. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, with a track record of analysing complex technical challenges and delivering scalable solutions. 
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams across distributed global R&D locations. 
  • Proven ability to mentor colleagues and elevate team code quality. 

  

R&D at AVEVA   

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.  

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it is the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration, and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.  



UK Benefits include:  

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

 

Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology

 

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our global Ratings Technology team in Manchester. This is your opportunity to not just build mission-critical applications, but to shape the future direction of technology that powers how a world-leading credit ratings agency delivers insights. Your leadership, architectural decisions, and vision will directly impact analysts, executives, and decision-makers who shape global financial markets.

You'll work closely with our talented engineering teams supporting Ratings workflow and analytical applications, influencing both technical architecture and organizational direction. We're looking for a seasoned technologist who thrives on challenging assumptions, experimenting with emerging technologies (especially AI), and pushing boundaries—not an MLE or AI specialist, but a full-stack engineer who's curious, unafraid to question the status quo, and excited to explore how AI can transform analytical workflows, as well as delivering high quality user experiences in their applications. This is a critical role for an organization expanding rapidly and building for the future, offering mobility and upward potential for the right visionary.

 

What We Offer:

  • Strategic leadership with organizational impact – Shape technical architecture and product direction for applications used by analysts worldwide, with high visibility to senior leadership and the ability to influence technology strategy across Ratings Technology
  • Innovation-first culture and experimentation – Permission to challenge established patterns, explore emerging technologies including AI, and drive proof-of-concepts with access to cutting-edge tools and a community that celebrates curiosity and bold thinking
  • Continuous learning and career growth – Training, certifications, conferences, mentorship opportunities, and clear paths to principal/architect/leadership tracks as you establish yourself as a thought leader
  • Flexibility and world-class environment – Work from premier offices in London, Manchester, or Toronto with hybrid flexibility, competitive compensation reflecting your seniority, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values both innovation and work-life harmony

 

We'll Count on You To:

  • Deliver technical excellence and build game-changing solutions – Design robust, scalable full-stack applications using Java/Springboot, C#/.NET, Python and REACT, drive architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and lead exploration of AI/ML integration opportunities that transform workflows
  • Offer influence and mentorship – Partner with product managers, analysts, and senior stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and psychological safety
  • Challenge the status quo and drive innovation – Question existing approaches, champion better solutions even when uncomfortable, experiment with emerging technologies, create proofs-of-concept, and push the organization toward what's possible rather than what's comfortable
  • Champion engineering excellence and quality – Implement CI/CD pipelines, conduct architecture reviews, solve complex performance and scalability challenges, establish best practices that scale across teams, and balance innovation with pragmatic delivery
  • Shape organizational and team direction – Influence team processes, lead strategic technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, bring fresh perspectives while respecting institutional knowledge, and model the curiosity, humility, and boldness needed across the organization
  • Own reliability and navigate complexity – Provide expert troubleshooting for sophisticated issues, maintain system performance at scale, balance multiple strategic priorities, and deliver excellence in fast-paced Agile environments

 

What You Need to Have:

  • Deep full-stack engineering expertise – 10+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise applications, with expert-level proficiency in  Java/Springboot and/or C#/.NET, good familiarity with Python, REACT and modern web technologies in production environments. 
  • Architectural mastery and technical depth – Proven track record of designing maintainable, scalable systems; excellent understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and the ability to make architectural decisions and live with their consequences
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Visionary problem-solving and growth mindset – Exceptional analytical abilities, demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, track record of experimentation and learning from failures, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills – Proven success with cross-functional teams, ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, and emotional intelligence to navigate organizational dynamics

 

What Would Make You Stand Out:

  • Modern engineering practices and DevOps prowess – Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and hands-on cloud expertise with microservices and cloud-native architecture
  • AI curiosity and exploration mindset – Genuine interest in how AI/ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation could transform software delivery, business processes, systems and applications; experience experimenting with new technologies and evaluating practical applications; comfort with emerging technology ambiguity
  • Financial services domain expertise – Experience with analytical workflows, regulatory processes, financial products, credit ratings, or understanding of how technology enables better decision-making
  • Agile mastery and change agent experience – Track record of establishing practices, challenging established patterns constructively, and creating space for teams to innovate and take calculated risks

 

If you are a seasoned technologist with a passion for innovation, a desire to shape organizational direction, and the courage to question the status quo, we would love to hear from you!

 

Why Choose Fitch:

 

  • Hybrid Work Environment: 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
  • A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
  • Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
  • Promoting Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body & mind
  • Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
  • Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives

 

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

jobTitle: Senior Engineer - HVDC Control System, Platform & Tools
jobDescription:
Job Description Summary

Become part of a winning team and help deliver the green energy transition. As electricity demand grows and transmission systems evolve, HVDC technology is becoming increasingly important in enabling the reliable integration of renewable power. At the centre of these systems are the control, software, and platform technologies that support safe, efficient, and high-performance operation.

GE Vernova is looking for an experienced Senior Engineer - HVDC Control System, Platform & Tools to join our HVDC NPI team. This senior role sits at the heart of next-generation R&D and new product introduction, driving innovation across embedded systems, software platforms, industrial communication technologies, and network and cyber architectures. You will provide technical authority, lead complex engineering initiatives, and support the development of the tools and platforms that underpin future HVDC systems.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical authority to NPI development teams working across embedded software, IEC-61850 PC-based applications, full stack web applications, and network and cyber architecture
  • Participate in design reviews for components, subassemblies, and key engineering deliverables during tendering and contract execution
  • Identify, develop, evaluate, and introduce engineering solutions that support business needs and market-winning proposals
  • Provide technical direction to projects during execution and support product, supplier, manufacturing, and field issue resolution
  • Guide teams on specification, design, architecture, testing, user documentation, and engineering best practice
  • Develop design practices, design guides, and support Design FMEAs, RCA, 5-Why, and 8-D activities as part of NPI development
  • Represent GE Vernova externally in conferences, industry bodies, and academic collaborations, and provide technical guidance in customer or supplier engagements where required
  • Support structured technical training, mentoring, lessons learned, and capability development across the HVDC organisation
  • Work closely with ITO, OTR, Technology, and Consulting Engineers to strengthen design quality, competency frameworks, and cross-functional collaboration

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
  • Strong hands-on experience in embedded software, desktop applications, full stack web applications, communication systems, or cybersecurity-related technologies
  • Expert knowledge of software development processes, including Agile development methodology
  • Experience acting as technical lead for NPI development programmes
  • Strong understanding of operating systems, including real-time operating systems such as VxWorks, RT Linux, or QNX, and desktop operating systems such as Linux, Unix, or Windows
  • Working knowledge of industrial protocols such as IEC-61850, IEC-104, DNP3, and Modbus
  • Very good understanding of the ISO OSI model and communication layers
  • Expert knowledge of processor and hardware technologies such as general-purpose processors, DSPs, FPGAs, and SoCs
  • Sound knowledge of computing technologies and backplanes such as PCIe, VPX, and SOSA
  • Good understanding of network and cyber architectures within industrial automation control systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills
  • Problem analysis and resolution capability
  • Ability to maintain engineering integrity in demanding situations
  • Lean experience
  • Knowledge of HVDC converter operation theory and associated power electronics
  • Knowledge of HVDC power system operations and control and protection theory
  • Development experience using MATLAB/Simulink
  • Hands-on experience with IEC-61850 SCT/ICT tools and data model development
  • Awareness of IEC-62443 cybersecurity standards

We do not expect applicants to meet all of the requirements listed. If your skills, experience, and strengths align with several key aspects of the role, we encourage you to apply.


Why Join GE Vernova

This role offers the opportunity to influence the digital and technical foundations of next-generation HVDC systems. You will work across software, communications, automation, and power system technologies, helping to deliver innovative solutions that support the global energy transition.


Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.


Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.


Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!


We're determined to be the best place to grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.


We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.


Inclusion & Diversity  

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.


As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.


Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

At Dunelm, that’s what we do.

Work your way, together

  • Accountable for ensuring the design, solutions and capabilities support delivering the business’ data and tech strategy.
  • Accountable for ensuring the alignment of technical solutions to architectural governance, data roadmaps and data strategy.
  • Accountable for driving continuous improvement across the core data platforms, including managing and remediating technical debt.
  • Accountable for managing the delivery of cost-effective solutions, monitoring consumption and identifying opportunities to optimise technology spend.

Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and mentoring to lead data engineers.
  • Leading on the creation and design of technical solutions for the FA, collaborating across teams to ensure solutions are delivered to expected timelines and quality.
  • Providing estimates for epics and stories with a specific focus on technical complexity and dependencies, working alongside product and Delivery to support planning.

Job Summary: 

The Software Development Engineer role at Clearwater Analytics spans a spectrum of responsibilities with a focus on designing, implementing, and managing software systems. The role requires continuous learning and application of new technologies and trends. Engineers at entry-level work on coding, debugging, and learning new software technologies. With progression in this track, the responsibilities expand to include leading teams, designing complex software systems, providing mentorship, and managing cross-functional integration. The more senior roles are responsible for defining the company's technological vision, making strategic decisions, driving innovation, and setting new industry standards. Across all levels, a successful software development engineer will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, excellent coding abilities, a keen understanding of the software ecosystem, and a cooperative team player attitude. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop fundamental software engineering skills. 

  • Successfully collaborate with peers in all aspects of software development. 

  • Complete simple coding deliverables with minimal supervision. 

  • Positively incorporate feedback from manager and mentor(s). 

  • Learn the team’s business domain. 

  • Take initiative to ask questions to clarify understanding. 

  • Actively and constructively participate in submitting code for review. 

  • Any other reasonable activity required by management. 

Required Skills:  

  • Fundamental understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. 

  • Basic programming skills in any modern language. 

  • Enthusiasm for software work in a software-as-a-service company. 

  • Driven by client satisfaction. 

  • Strong teamwork skills. 

  • Ability to manage own time and deliver expected results on time. 

  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement. 

  • Exceptional analytical skills. 

  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.  

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.  

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.  

  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. 

  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities. 

 

Education and Experience:  

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field. 

 

  • a plus
